description: This file defines the EmployeeOnLeaveSearchFilterParams class, which extends FilterParams and serves as a Data Transfer Object (DTO) for filtering employee leave search results based on date and accessible employee numbers within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: EmployeeOnLeaveSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class that encapsulates filtering parameters for employee leave searches, including date and accessible employee numbers.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters with a default sort field.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Returns the date used for filtering employee leave records.

methods.name: setDate
methods.description: Sets the date to filter employee leave records.

methods.name: getAccessibleEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the list of accessible employee numbers for filtering.

methods.name: setAccessibleEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the list of accessible employee numbers for filtering.
